resolutionRule: For one simulated property, the strongest authored opinion wins: an openUsdPhysics:* opinion overrides a physx* opinion, which overrides a standard physics:* opinion. An unsupported extension property produces a property-specific diagnostic and never suppresses supported semantics on the same object.

namespaces.description: Project-owned OpenUsdPhysics schema. Strongest opinion and the only namespace this repository defines.

Foreign physx* opinions authored by other tools. Treated as an optional raw input that is read when present and never required. No PhysxSchema definitions are vendored; see schemas/third-party/physxSchema/PROVENANCE.md.
Standard UsdPhysics schema shipped with OpenUSD. Weakest opinion.

gaps.reason: Covered by OpenUsdPhysicsFixedTendon, OpenUsdPhysicsSpatialTendon, and OpenUsdPhysicsTendonAttachmentAPI.

Covered by OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSystemAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSetAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsParticleClothAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsPbdMaterialAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsDiffuseParticlesAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsParticleAnisotropyAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSmoothingAPI, and OpenUsdPhysicsParticleIsosurfaceAPI.
Covered by OpenUsdPhysicsCookedDataAPI. The schema references cooked data produced at build time and never embeds it.
Covered by OpenUsdPhysicsSceneAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsRigidBodySettingsAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsCollisionSettingsAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsMaterialSettingsAPI, and OpenUsdPhysicsArticulationSettingsAPI.

Every class is single-apply so that each property keeps the flat 'openUsdPhysics:<group>:<name>' shape the precedence rule depends on. Domains that need several instances on one object are modelled as concrete prims instead.
